banks.bank: Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe

note: The Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe's price list (Preçário BISTP 2026, in force from 1 January 2026, 59 pages), section 1.1, a private customer's demand deposit account, read on 2026-11-03: opening is free but asks a first deposit of at least 1,000 dobras for an account in dobras; keeping it costs, each month, 11 dobras on an average balance up to 500, 14 above 500 up to 1,250, and 25 above 1,250. The tiers are written as three fees, each waived on an average daily balance outside its band (the lowest on one of 500.01 or more, the middle on one of 500 or less or of 1,250.01 or more, the highest on one of 1,250 or less), so exactly one is charged. The 3.5% stamp duty the list adds to each fee isn't written: the account's form has no tax term. A minor's account (up to 1,250 on average) costs nothing, a separate account for those under 18 that isn't written; the 760-dobra yearly charge on an account left without movement for over a year isn't written, the game not keeping a dormant account.

Despesas de Imobilização de Contas D.O (Anual) 760,00 - 760,00 I.Selo (3,5%) ... Nota (2) Apesar de não existir comissão, a abertura de conta à ordem para particulares implica o depósito de um valor mínimo de 1.000,00 Db para contas em dobras, 100,00 EUR para contas em EUR e 100,00 USD para contas em USD.
